thought.text: The first callback (302) succeeded and consumed the one-shot login state; my second attempt hit it again and got 400. I need to follow the 302 to the claim-selection page. Let me check the callback redirect target and redo the flow capturing the redirect:

reasoning_content:
The callback failed with "missing_login_state". This is a session state issue. Let me understand the login state mechanism. The login_start stores state in the session (admin_oidc_login), and the callback consumes it. The issue: when I did the callback with `-b cookies.txt`, it seems the session cookie wasn't properly matched, OR the state got consumed.

Actually, the key issue: the callback at 11:15:58 returned 302 (this was the FIRST time I hit the callback). But then I hit it again at 11:16:00 and got "missing_login_state" (400). So the FIRST callback (302) actually succeeded in consuming the state and redirecting somewhere. But I overwrote/didn't follow it properly.

Wait, let me re-read. First `callback:` attempt returned 302 (that was the real, valid callback that consumed the login state and redirected, likely to the select-claim page). Then my second attempt at the same URL got 400 missing_login_state because the state was already consumed.

So the FIRST 302 was the correct flow. But I didn't capture the Location of that first 302. The problem is the callback is a one-shot — it consumes the OIDC login state. Once you get a 302, that was the redirect to the select-claim page (or dashboard).

Let me look at the callback controller logic. When in bootstrap mode and callback succeeds, it should redirect to the select-claim page. Let me check.

Actually, let me reconsider. The state is stored in the session as `admin_oidc_login`. On the first callback (302), it validated the state, stashed bootstrap claims, and redirected to `/admin/bootstrap/select-claim`. That's the one-shot. I need to redo the whole flow and this time FOLLOW the 302 redirect from the callback to capture the select-claim page.

Let me redo the entire flow cleanly in one script, following redirects at each step so I don't consume state without capturing the next page.

Let me check what the callback redirects to on success in bootstrap mode.

action.command: cd /workspace && grep -n -A40 "def bootstrap_callback" server/lib/nebu/admin/auth.ex | grep -iE "redirect|to: |send_resp|select_claim|dashboard" | head
